description: This file contains utility functions for splitting strings into a linked list of tokens, specifically in the context of a to-do list application.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A singleton object providing string splitting utilities, including splitting a source string into tokens and adding valid tokens to a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens based on spaces and returns a linked list containing the valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the linked list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether the given token is valid (not empty).
